title: Setting someone's roles is simpler
description: The user editor now ticks roles independently instead of a ranked ladder, and only shows the settings that change something for that person.
items: Tick every role a person holds; HR is one of the ticks
The departments someone leads only appear for a team leader — every role above already sees every department
The department admin switch is gone: managing a department's forms and lists is for team leaders and up
The old business manager switch is gone; business manager is a role
